in_process.interface: ILatticeTenantAdmin, ILatticeTenantRegionAdmin, ILatticeTenantAccessAdmin, ILatticeTenantGrantAdmin, ILatticeTenantSelfService, ILatticeTenantQuotaUsage

grpc.marshalling: Unary RPCs use Orleans serializers through LatticeTenantAdminGrpcMarshallers.

metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Carries the caller credential token; the default bridge strips the Bearer scheme and stamps LatticeCredentialContext.

metadata.name: lattice-active-tenant
metadata.purpose: Carries the caller asserted active tenant and is stamped through LatticeActiveTenantAssertion.

auth.decision: RequireAuthorization defaults true; DenyTenantAdminApiAuthorizer denies until opt-in; GetAuthScheme and self-service methods are exempt and defer to facade scoping.

errors.condition: Invalid tenant id or subject id.
Caller is neither platform operator nor target tenant admin.
Reserved default tenant target.
Tenant access-administration facade is not registered.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; configure retries on the caller or CallInvoker.

idempotency.basis: Adding an existing admin subject reports Changed false.

concurrency.rule: Admin-subject mutations are stamped through the tenant record CRDT merge.

errors.condition: No such grant was offered.
Grant is not pending.
Caller is not platform operator and not an admin of the grantee tenant.
Cross-tenant grant facade is not registered.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; repeated approval of an active grant is idempotent.

concurrency.rule: Concurrent grant transitions converge on the more restrictive outcome.

errors.condition: A revoked region is still resident.
Caller is not a platform operator.
Region-residency facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Retry only when resubmitting the same complete allowed-region set.

idempotency.basis: The call sets the allowed set to exactly the supplied regions.

concurrency.rule: Residency must stay a subset of the allowed set; revoking a resident region is refused.

errors.condition: Tenant id is already registered.
Invalid tenant id or admin subject.
Caller is not authorized to administer tenants.

retry.policy: Create is not an idempotent upsert; retry can observe AlreadyExists after a successful first attempt.

idempotency.basis: Create fails with TenantAlreadyExistsException when the tenant is already registered.

concurrency.rule: The facade refuses a duplicate tenant id rather than resetting an existing definition.

errors.condition: Tenant id is not registered.
Tenant id is the reserved default tenant.
Caller is not authorized to administer tenants.

retry.policy: Retry after a successful delete observes NotFound.

idempotency.basis: Delete fails closed with TenantNotFoundException when the tenant is absent.

concurrency.rule: Deletes cascade tenant-owned tree soft deletes before removing the registry record.

retry.policy: Unauthenticated read-only advertisement.

concurrency.rule: No state mutation.

errors.condition: Active tenant assertion is not valid for the caller.

retry.policy: Read-only self-service operation.

concurrency.rule: No state mutation.

errors.condition: Tenant does not exist or caller is not authorized to see it.

retry.policy: Read-only self-service operation.

concurrency.rule: Absent and unauthorized tenants are deliberately indistinguishable.

errors.condition: Tenant does not exist or caller is not authorized to read it.
Quota usage facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Read-only tenant-tier operation.

concurrency.rule: Reads the tenancy engine warm per-tenant usage index.

errors.condition: Tenant does not exist.
Caller is neither platform operator nor tenant admin.
Region-residency facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Read-only tenant-tier operation.

concurrency.rule: Reports one row per region that is either allowed or carries a non-None status.

errors.condition: Active tenant assertion is not valid for the caller.

retry.policy: Read-only self-service operation.

concurrency.rule: Enumeration is scoped to the caller resolved subject and omits tenants the caller cannot see.

errors.condition: Tenant does not exist for an operator caller.
Caller is neither platform operator nor tenant admin.
Cross-tenant grant facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Read-only tenant-tier operation.

concurrency.rule: Lists issued and received grants in every lifecycle state.

errors.condition: Tenant does not exist for an operator caller.
Caller is neither platform operator nor tenant admin.
Tenant access-administration facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Read-only tenant-tier operation.

concurrency.rule: Lists live tenant-admin subjects in ordinal order.

errors.condition: A live active grant exists for the same grantee and scope or a reserved tenant was targeted.
Caller is not platform operator and not an admin of the granting tenant.
Cross-tenant grant facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Retry only when resubmitting the same offer terms.

idempotency.basis: Re-offering over a pending offer amends terms; re-offering over a terminal grant starts a fresh agreement.

concurrency.rule: Grant writes are stamped through the tenant record CRDT merge and concurrent transitions converge on the more restrictive outcome.

errors.condition: No such grant was offered.
Grant is not pending.
Caller is not platform operator and not an admin of the grantee tenant.
Cross-tenant grant facade is not registered.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; repeated rejection of a rejected grant is idempotent.

concurrency.rule: Concurrent grant transitions converge on the more restrictive outcome.

errors.condition: Removal would leave no admin subjects or the reserved default tenant was targeted.
Caller is neither platform operator nor target tenant admin.
Tenant access-administration facade is not registered.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; removing a non-member reports Changed false.

idempotency.basis: Removing a subject that is not a member reports Changed false.

concurrency.rule: Concurrent removals that would empty the set are detected on the registry merged result and repaired before refusal.

errors.condition: Tenant id is not registered.
Caller is not authorized to administer tenants.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; resuming an already-active tenant is idempotent.

idempotency.basis: Resuming an already-active tenant reports Changed false.

concurrency.rule: Status transition is written through the tenant registry record.

errors.condition: No such grant exists.
Grant is not active.
Caller is platform operator for neither tenant and admin of neither party.
Cross-tenant grant facade is not registered.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; repeated revocation of a revoked grant is idempotent.

concurrency.rule: Concurrent grant transitions converge on the more restrictive outcome.

errors.condition: Tenant id is not registered.
Tenant id is the reserved default tenant.
Invalid tenant id or negative burst percent.
Caller is not authorized to administer tenants.

retry.policy: Retry is safe when resubmitting the same quota descriptor.

idempotency.basis: Replacing quotas with the same descriptor is idempotent.

concurrency.rule: Quota descriptor replaces the tenant current quotas in the registry record.

errors.condition: Requested region is not allowed or the change removes the last resident region.
Caller is neither platform operator nor tenant admin.
Region-residency facade is not registered.

retry.policy: Retry is safe when resubmitting the same complete residency set.

idempotency.basis: Setting the same residency set is idempotent; invalid sets are refused.

concurrency.rule: The last-resident-region guard runs before the write and again after the CRDT join to handle concurrent removals.

errors.condition: Tenant id is not registered.
Tenant id is the reserved default tenant.
Caller is not authorized to administer tenants.

retry.policy: No facade retry policy is defined; suspending an already-suspended tenant is idempotent.

idempotency.basis: Suspending an already-suspended tenant reports Changed false.

concurrency.rule: Status transition is written through the tenant registry record.

error_taxonomy.meaning: A create attempted to register an existing tenant.
The request was cancelled before completion.

error_taxonomy.type: ReservedTenantOperationException, TenantLastAdminSubjectException, TenantLastRegionException, TenantGrantTransitionException, TenantRegionNotAllowedException, InvalidOperationException
error_taxonomy.meaning: Cluster state or reserved-target invariants refused a well-formed request.
Unhandled facade or binding failure after logging.
The tenant or grant is absent, or a facade deliberately unifies unauthorized visibility with absence.
The transport authorizer, access gate, or active-tenant validation denied the caller.
An optional tenant facade is not registered on the host.
